<pos> m. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (ὑάκινθος; די for הי or יי to avoid the use of letters of the Tetragrammaton; Ar. reads ייקינטין) 
<italic>hyacinth</italic>, a precious stone.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 38, end לוי ד' (not דייקני') Levi was represented on the Highpriests’ breast-plate by a hyacinth (h. ברקת). Y’lamd. to Deut. X, 1, quot. in Ar. המרגליות ויי' (Yalk. ib. 854 דייקוסנין, דייקינטין, corr. acc.) the pearls and hyacinths. Gen. R. s. 79, end (after interpreting ק̇ש̇ט̇ in ק̇ש̇י̇ט̇ה̇, Gen. XXXIII, 19) what function have 
<italic>Yod Hé</italic> here? [read:] אלו חליות ד' וזמרגדין שדרכן וכ' (v. ‘Rashi’ a. l. a. Yalk. ib. 134) these are the links of hyacinths and smaragds with which jewelry is decorated, i.e. the vowel letters connecting the consonants, but which also have an allegorical meaning (v. the sentence following: מי כותב וכ').</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<italic>to be silent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Denom. (דִּימָה,) דָּמוּת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to imagine, compare</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Denom. דְּמוּת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (denom. of דְּמוּת) 
<italic>to resemble, be like, to imitate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 133
<sup>b</sup> הוי דֹומֶה לו imitate Him. Ber. 29
<sup>b</sup> שתפלתו דֹומָה עליו וכ' to whom his prayer appears like a burden. Taan. 22
<sup>b</sup> אין דורו דומה יפה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) his generation was not considered worthy. B. Kam. 92
<sup>b</sup>; Yalk. Jud. 67 ובן אדם לדו' לו (not ובני) and man associates with his equal. Sifra Sh’mini Par. 10, ch. XII; Ḥull. 76
<sup>b</sup> הַדֹּומֶה that which resembles the animal specified in the Bible (species); הד' לַדֹּומֶה what resembles the animal classified with the animal specified in the Bible (genus); a. fr.—אֵינֹו דֹומֶה there is no resemblance, 
<italic>you cannot compare</italic>. Yeb. 64
<sup>a</sup> א' ד' תפלת … לתפלת וכ' you cannot compare the prayer of … to the prayer of &c. Sabb. 119
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Hull. 48
<sup>b</sup> זו דֹומָה לזו these are analogous cases, v. Pi.—(משל) למה הדבר דומה (abbrev. מלה"ד, לה"ד) (a simile:) to what can this be compared?, a phrase introducing a simile. Taan. 25
<sup>b</sup>. Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִדְמָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to be silenced, undone</italic>].</definition>
<notes>].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be compared, to be imagined; to appear in the disguise of; to seem</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 32
<sup>b</sup> כמה"ש נִדְמוּ לו that they appeared to him as ministering angels; נדמו לו לערביים they appeared to him as if they were Arabs. Succ. 52
<sup>a</sup> צדיקים נ' להם כהר וכ' to the righteous sin will appear like a high mount; a. fr.—נִדְמֶה an animal 
<italic>suspected</italic> to be a hybrid or looking like one (cmp. דְּמַאי), esp. 
<italic>a lamb looking like a kid</italic>, and vice versa. Bekh. 12
<sup>a</sup> ‘a ewe which gave birth to what looked like a kid’. Ḥull. 38
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>דִּימָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to compare, judge from analogy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 32 דִּמִּיתִיךָ להם I made thee like them (beasts). B. Bath. 130
<sup>b</sup> ובלבד שלא יְדַמֶּה וכ' but one must not decide ritual cases by analogy; v. Ḥull. 48
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to have an opinion</italic> without authority to refer to.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 19
<sup>a</sup>; 37
<sup>a</sup> מפני שאנו מְדַמִּין because we have such an opinion.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְדוּמֶּה, pl. מְדוּמִּין; כמ' אני 
<italic>it seems to me</italic>, כמ' אנו 
<italic>it seems to us</italic> &c. Men. 18
<sup>a</sup>. Taan. 23
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> bot. כמ' הייתי I thought.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> דַּמְיָין מעייהו ל־ their entrails look like those of human beings; a. fr.—Pes. 14
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מי דָמֵי is this like (the other)?, i.e. there is no analogy between them.</notes></sense></senses>

<italic>to make a thing, otherwise exempt, subject to the law of T’rumah, to mix secular grain, wine, oil &c. with T’rumah in proportions sufficient to make the whole prohibited to non-priests;</italic> in gen. 
<italic>to mix secular with sacred things.</italic></definition>
<notes> Orl. II, 4; 6 המְדַמֵּעַ; a. fr.—Ter. III, 1 אינה מְדַמַּעַת וכ' does not make 
<italic>Dema</italic> by itself (if mixed with secular fruits). Ib. 2 אינה מְדַמֵּעֲתָן does not make them 
<italic>dema;</italic> מְדַמְּעֹות כקטנה וכ' make 
<italic>dema</italic>, the smallest of the two being considered as an admixture; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְדוּמָּע. Ib. V, 6 אין המדומע מדמע וכ' that which became subject to the law of T’rumah through an admixture, can affect a second mixture only in proportion, i.e. according to the quantity of real T’rumah contained therein. Ḥag. III, 4 wine jars or oil jars המְדוּמָּעֹות which have been mixed up; expl. ib. 25
<sup>b</sup> מד' דקדש containing liquids, a portion of which was designated for libations.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
